dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's not as hard as you think. You just have to be determined!

dialogues.speaker: Nadyushenka
dialogues.text: But what if... What if I lose my Mora to a cheat? Hmm. I suppose I could go be a part-timer for money somewhere then.

dialogues.speaker: Nadyushenka
dialogues.text: But what if the mine wouldn't hire me? I guess I could be a kvass promoter at a restaurant too.

dialogues.speaker: Nadyushenka
dialogues.text: And if the restaurant doesn't sell kvass, I can... I can...

dialogues.speaker: Nadyushenka
dialogues.text: *Sigh* Adventures really are tough. I'd better think some more. Yes, I should think some more before I set out for sure.
